name: definition-table-year-number-collision
description: Invalid definition (fiscalclock 0.3.0). Illustrative table years 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-30 and 2024-12-31 to 2025-12-31, each one period. Numbered by 'start', both get 2024. Year numbering runs over the years the table covers. The complete error list is asserted (code, path and details).

source.citation: spec/definition-v1.md, Year numbers must be unique and type table (fiscalclock 0.3.0)
